findings.body: The receipt-based repair still misses tasks and fixes whose checks pass after close stopped waiting. Close saves `waiting for checks` before waiting, and writes the ready receipt only after success (src/forge/close.py:174–218). Without that receipt, this field remains `waiting for checks` even when the fetched checks pass and `_item` reports ready to merge under human-merge policy (src/forge/nextstep.py:578–595). This is new evidence beyond the previously reviewed successful-close case: tests/test_machine_views.py:151–158 already exercises readiness without a receipt, but never asserts the stage. Derive the displayed stage from that validated check evidence too, for both task children and fixes.
findings.title: Not done: report the current stage when checks become green

findings.body: VIEWS explicitly owns the JSON fields from details 1–4, including `approval.doc`, but every returned row omits approval data. A waiting story therefore supplies no absolute path to its document in its own worktree, which the APPROVE consumer is required to read instead of the session checkout's copy. The existing worktree mapping and approval.waiting_digest (src/forge/approval.py:84–90) provide the necessary evidence without depending on the later approval-button implementation. Add the field and cover a waiting story in the shared command contract; the current fixture contains only a fix and cannot detect this omission.
findings.title: Include the waiting story's approval document in board JSON

findings.body: When a newer release exists, release_notice prepends `Forge … is out …` (src/forge/upgrade.py:168–188). Passing those combined lines to machine_next makes `next.line` that notice, because it selects the first non-Next line, while `next.command` still belongs to the actual item. For a waiting item or human-only merge with a null command, the machine view consequently loses the state explaining what it is waiting for. Build the machine next object from `_report`'s lines and preserve the release notice separately if needed.
findings.title: Keep release notices from replacing next.line
